question: Estimate the number of EV charging points operational in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Public charging only or include private home chargers? Public only.
Both AC + DC fast chargers? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Direct from MoP / OMC / charge point operator data.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: These test your ability to handle seasonal spikes and concentrated event-driven demand. The pattern: take a normal-day baseline, multiply by a behaviorally justified uplift (festive, sports event, religious gathering), and validate against operator disclosures or news coverage.

calculationFlow: Plus private (housing societies, captive office): ~2-3 lakh additional.
